detail_text: Specifically, Your firm produced non-sterile and sterile drugs while construction was underway in an adjacent area to <Redaced B4>. Controls and cleaning frequency may not be adequate to prevent contamination of the production environment and product. Dust was observed in the IS07 lab. Entry to your non-sterile lab comes directly from a carpeted hallway and entry to the ISO controlled areas comes directly from the non-stelile lab directly adjacent to the new construction. There is construction containment in the hallway. An unused door in the non-sterile lab that leads directly to the new construction area was unsealed. There was no indication of carpet cleaning and no protective devices to prevent contamination from the carpet into the non-sterile lab
